library.name: gas_production
library.description: The gas production benchmark (Labeau and Dutuit 2004; Eymard and Mercier 2008) as a component type library: two production units and the buffer reservoir that covers their shortfall.

types.name: ProductionUnit
types.description: A production unit: up or down, failing at `failure_rate` and at `failure_rate_at_max` while it runs at its maximum, repaired after a lognormal duration. It exports whether it is up on `up_out`. With `refill`, its repair refills the reservoir at once when the other unit is up.

parameters.name: failure_rate
parameters.description: Failure rate at partial load, in 1/h.

parameters.name: failure_rate_at_max
parameters.description: Failure rate while running at its maximum, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_mu
parameters.description: Mean of the logarithm of the repair duration (ln h).

parameters.name: repair_sigma
parameters.description: Standard deviation of the logarithm of the repair duration.

parameters.name: refill
parameters.description: Whether a repair that brings both units up refills the reservoir at once (cases 1 to 3).

parameters.name: at_max_while_filling
parameters.description: Whether the unit also runs at its maximum while the reservoir is not full (case 4).

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Reservoir capacity, in m3: the level a refill restores.

types.name: BufferReservoir
types.description: The reservoir covering the units' shortfall: its level follows the net flow, held at 0 while empty and at the capacity while full. It reads which unit is up on `unit1_up_in` and `unit2_up_in`, publishes its level on `level_out` and whether it is full on `full_out`, and computes the delivered share of the demand.

parameters.name: net_unit1_alone
parameters.description: Net flow with U1 up alone, in m3/h.

parameters.name: net_unit2_alone
parameters.description: Net flow with U2 up alone, in m3/h.

parameters.name: net_none
parameters.description: Net flow with both units down, in m3/h.

parameters.name: net_filling
parameters.description: Net flow with both units up while it refills (case 4), in m3/h.

parameters.name: share_unit1
parameters.description: Delivered share of the demand with U1 alone and the reservoir empty.

parameters.name: share_unit2
parameters.description: Delivered share of the demand with U2 alone and the reservoir empty.

parameters.name: filling
parameters.description: Whether both units up refill it at their maximum instead of keeping it as it is (case 4).
